offline.title: Pending changes ({count})
offline.subtitle: Saved on this device and waiting to reach the server, in the order they will be sent.
offline.subtitleOffline: You are offline. These changes are saved on this device and will be sent when you reconnect.
offline.blockedHint: The server rejected this. Retrying as-is will fail again — fix the cause, or discard it.

discard.title: Discard this change?
discard.body: This change will never be sent to the server. The record stays on this device only, so the server will not have it — you would need to enter it again. This cannot be undone.

toast.offlineBody: Reconnect to send your pending changes.
toast.partialBody: {pushed} sent, {stuck} still stuck. Open the details for the reason.
toast.discardedBody: It will not be sent to the server.

badge.syncingTitle: Sending your locally-saved changes to the server.
badge.offlineTitle: You are offline. Click to review the changes saved on this device.
badge.blockedTitle: The server rejected some changes. Click to review.
badge.failedTitle: Some changes could not sync yet. Click to review.
badge.pendingTitle: Waiting to sync. Click to review and sync now.

linkedPayments.editTitle: Delete the linked payment(s) and save?
linkedPayments.editBody: This invoice has {count} linked payment(s) totaling {total}. It can't be edited while they exist. Deleting them reverses the related cash, party balance and accounting entries, then your changes are saved. This cannot be undone.
linkedPayments.deleteBody: This invoice has {count} linked payment(s) totaling {total}. Deleting the invoice will also delete them and reverse the related cash and accounting entries. This cannot be undone.
linkedPayments.sharedWarning: One or more of these payments also cover other invoices, so they can't be deleted automatically. Open the payment and remove or re-allocate it first, then try again.
